machineVercel.description: Sandboxes that keep their files between runs.
machineVercel.timeoutDescription: Leave empty to use your plan maximum: 45 minutes on Hobby; 24 hours on Pro and Enterprise. Enter a shorter duration if needed. Happier does not extend runs automatically.
machineVercel.retentionDescription: Use 0 for no expiry. Retained snapshots are billed after the sandbox stops.
machineVercel.tokenDescription: Use a personal access token for the selected team or project. Sandboxes also require team plan access.
machineVercel.teamIdDescription: Find it in Vercel, under Team settings.
machineVercel.projectIdDescription: Required for sandboxes and project-scoped tokens. Find it in Vercel, under Project settings.
machineVercel.checkUnavailable: Vercel account unavailable. Check the token, team, and project.
machineVercel.confirmBody: Vercel bills running compute and retained snapshots. Files can persist across runs; process memory cannot.
machineVercel.nativeCredentialConfirmBod: The selected credential key may be disclosed to Vercel’s control plane, separate from the provisioning token. Vercel keeps the key outside the guest, but the source custodian and Vercel remain trusted. Installed requests bypass Happier’s per-request authorization, body/model policy and request, token or cost limits. Vendor matchers narrow key substitution; they do not inspect model JSON or deny unmatched requests. Configure budgets and key restrictions at the Gateway/vendor; coverage is not verified here. Installed rules may continue while the controller is offline, when changes and removal cannot be guaranteed. Upstream key rotation or revocation is the independent hard stop; previously disclosed bytes cannot be recalled. Attribution is observational, not authenticated member identity or chargeback. Members sharing an OS user can read and reuse each other’s placeholders; these are not private between members.
machineVercel.deleteBody: Deletes this sandbox and its owned snapshots. Its files cannot be recovered after deletion.
machineVercel.signInTeamIdDescription: Leave empty to choose from your teams after you sign in.
machineVercel.projectRequired: Choose a Vercel project for Sandboxes
